verdict.rationale: A business-filing service could plausibly offer event-triggered automation, such as rules that act on filing status changes, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents user-defined rules, triggers or automatic actions. The Gateway and tax items cover only profiles, login, guides and filing, and the probes show ohiosos.gov blocks agents at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
